description: This file defines a React component 'CompactWorkflowsTable' for rendering a dynamic, searchable, sortable table of workflow summaries in a web UI. It manages workflow selection, deletion, and displays detailed info such as status, last activity, and VC verification badges.

methods.name: RelativeTime
methods.description: Renders a relative time string (e.g., '5m ago') based on a timestamp.

methods.name: WorkflowHoverCard
methods.description: Displays detailed workflow info in a hover tooltip, including IDs, agent, status, executions, and session.

methods.name: WorkflowVCStatusCell
methods.description: Displays VC verification status badge or loading skeleton.
